seo.title: CVS Health: conversation intelligence on 100% of calls (Cresta) - predictive CSAT (2025)
seo.meta_description: CVS Health now scores 100% of its member calls versus 5% before, with predictive CSAT via Cresta, and extends Salesforce Agentforce AI agents to millions of members.
seo.resume_citable: CVS Health, which serves 185 million people a year, went from scoring 5% to 100% of its calls by deploying Cresta's conversation intelligence with a predictive CSAT on every call, and is extending Salesforce Agentforce Health AI agents to its Aetna and Caremark members.

faq.q: What did conversation intelligence change at CVS Health?
faq.a: The company scored 5% of its calls manually; with Cresta, it scores 100% and computes a predictive CSAT on every call, with a near-immediate reduction in after-call work for advisors.

faq.q: What is the role of Salesforce Agentforce Health?
faq.a: It adds a layer of AI agents that assist Aetna and CVS Caremark advisors in resolving member requests faster, across a scope of several tens of millions of members.

pattern: conversation intelligence and AI agents on 100% of contact center calls
objectif_business: Move from a sample of manually scored calls to reading 100% of contact center interactions, to measure satisfaction on every call, reduce advisors' after-call work, and detect issues in real time rather than after weeks of surveys.
description: CVS Health deployed Cresta's conversation intelligence in its member contact center. The company used to score 5% of its calls; it now scores 100%. The starting point was automatic call summarization, which reduced advisors' after-call work, before opening up a predictive satisfaction score (CSAT) on every call. CVS Health serves 185 million people a year. In parallel, the company is extending a layer of AI agents via Salesforce Agentforce Health for its Aetna and CVS Caremark businesses, across a scope of several tens of millions of members.
points_cles: Conversation intelligence applied to 100% of member contact center calls.
Cresta platform (summarization, predictive CSAT) plus Salesforce Agentforce Health agents.
Share of scored calls raised from 5% to 100%, across 185 million people served a year.

resultats.metrique: Share of calls scored by AI
People served a year (CVS Health member relations)

niveau_preuve.justification: The central result (going from 5% to 100% of scored calls, predictive CSAT) is documented by a quantified platform case study (Cresta), corroborated by a CVS/Salesforce announcement on the deployment of AI agents at the scale of several tens of millions of members. Quantified vendor case study = B.

stack_technique.detail: contact center conversation intelligence: transcription, automatic call summarization, and predictive CSAT on 100% of calls
contact center AI agents for Aetna and CVS Caremark members, extension announced in 2026
speech-to-text component integrated into the conversation platform, a prerequisite for summarization and scoring

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real time on every call, with continuous post-call analysis
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: CVS Health customer experience and insights leadership, above the contact center teams
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The content of the transcribed calls and the predictive CSAT computed on it. Without reliable transcription or a consent basis for call analysis, coverage falls back to the manual sample it started from.

etapes.detail: Every member call is transcribed and made analyzable.
The system generates a call summary that lightens the advisor's after-call work.
A predictive CSAT is computed on 100% of calls, with a per-advisor view.
The teams spot issues in real time and act without waiting for a survey.
AI agents (Agentforce Health) assist Aetna and Caremark advisors with members.

prerequis_data: CSAT history to train the scoring
a consent basis for call analysis
replication.premiere_etape: Wire up call transcription and launch automatic summarization as a first, fast-ROI use case.

playbook.action: Set the compliance framework (call recording, consent, health data) and contract the platform.
playbook.livrable: Validated compliance file and signed contract

playbook.action: Wire transcription onto the calls and launch automatic summarization on a pilot team.
playbook.livrable: Summaries in limited production, after-call time measured before / after

playbook.action: Generalize automatic summarization and calibrate the predictive CSAT on the history of manual scores.
playbook.livrable: Predictive scoring validated against the manually scored sample

playbook.action: Move to 100% of calls scored with dashboards per team and per advisor.
playbook.livrable: Full call coverage with management views

playbook.action: Set up the real-time remediation loop on the customer experience side, without waiting for surveys.

replication.equipe: 1 customer experience lead + 1 contact center project manager + telephony IT, with legal and compliance in support

statut_vivant.note: Cresta deployment documented in late 2025 with live results, and Agentforce Health extension announced in mid-2026. Active and recent momentum on member relations at the contact center.

transposable_ue.note: AI analysis of recorded calls and predictive satisfaction scoring touch health data and voice recordings. In the EU, a GDPR legal basis and member information are required, call recording is governed by national law, and AI Act vigilance applies to behavioral analysis. Health data falls under Article 9 GDPR.
